attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Dentistry (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or approved by accredited educational institutions, Board-recognized professional associations and societies, accredited post-doctoral programs, federal/state/local government health agencies and institutions, accredited community and teaching hospitals (criteria developed by the Rhode Island Dental Association, approved by the Board). Self-instructed courses incl. Internet courses need a post-test; they may cover the full requirement.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pro-rated for licenses in effect less than 2 years.
rules.audit_note: Attestation at renewal; keep course descriptions and proof of attendance at least 5 years for random audit.

topics.who: Licensees practicing in a dental setting: at least 1 hour per year on the CDC infection control guidelines
Current hands-on BLS for Healthcare Providers; max 3 credits

rules.notes: Renewal by May 1 of even years. Current hands-on BLS for Healthcare Providers required (CPR course max 3 credits). Public health dental hygienists need 12 extra hours before practicing in that role.
